description: Java class representing an integration module configuration within the sales management system, including database mappings, audit info, and module properties.

classes.name: IntegrationModule
classes.description: Entity class for module configuration, including properties like module name, code, regions, configuration details, image, and audit info.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns the details map containing additional configuration info.

methods.name: setDetails
methods.description: Sets the details map with additional configuration info.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the module.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the module.

methods.name: getModuleConfigs
methods.description: Returns the map of module configurations by environment.

methods.name: setModuleConfigs
methods.description: Sets the map of module configurations.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image URL or path.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or path.

methods.name: isCustomModule
methods.description: Returns whether the module is custom.

methods.name: setCustomModule
methods.description: Sets whether the module is custom.
